knowledge_point.title: Finding the Pivot Columns of a Matrix in Row Echelon Form

question.:question/problem:
The row echelon form matrix $A$ is given below. What are the pivot columns of $A?$

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}-2 & 3 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}
$$

Select all that apply.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Remember that the pivots of a matrix in row echelon form are the first non-zero entries in each row of the matrix.

We can see that $A$ has $2$ pivots in the $1$st and $3$rd columns:

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}-2 & 3 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}
$$
